name: What are the benefits of building an attached ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an attached ADU offers several advantages. It can significantly increase your property value and provide a source of rental income, contributing to mortgage payments or property taxes. For families, it offers flexible space for aging parents, adult children, or a dedicated home office. Attached ADUs can also be more cost-effective to construct than detached units, as they often leverage existing utility connections and foundation elements from the main house. They also minimize the impact on yard space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Attached ADUs increase property value, generate rental income, provide flexible living space for family, and can be more cost-effective to build than detached units.
